---
description: Build and validation after project changes.
applyTo: "**/*"
---
# Build verification

Select the narrowest relevant build or test first, then expand when shared contracts, SDK targets or installers change. Use actual solution/projects and documented SDKs; account for Revit version-specific builds and Windows dependencies. When tools or Revit are unavailable, clearly report what could not be checked. Do not claim a successful build or working MSI from static inspection alone.
